1445-2438-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2438-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

413-3661-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
413-3661-5006-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. When Shield Sphere enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

2023-4359-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-1734-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2783-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

413-4559-6753-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-4559-6753-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2034-6970-7730-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

789-1263-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

225-1170-7069-7529.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate any land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}. 
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

1322-2105-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-7060.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

575-2653-5971-7097.notablePrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-2653-5971-7097.description:
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Nissa and Zimone trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2584-3197-6919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
2584-3197-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Herd Baloth.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-3129-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-3129-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1850-2167-5967.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2167-5967.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

144-628-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

372-2781-4142.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2781-4142.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian exiled by Hostage Taker
372-2781-4142.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Hostage Taker and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Hostage Taker to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Hostage Taker and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Hostage Taker and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-5241-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima's Student has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-5241-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima's Student and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima's Student from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima's Student to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima's Student by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

240-526-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg, adding one mana of any color.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Repeat.
240-526-4050.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

333-413-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-413-5617.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Shepherd of the Cosmos trigger, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

282-749-1558-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least four nontoken creatures.
282-749-1558-3263.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of Lena with haste.
When the Lena token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Lena token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

413-2073-2364-4139.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Mana Vault, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2577-2899-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2577-2899-4871.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield as a 1/0 due to Kaervek, and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1887-2060-4153.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control besides Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1887-2060-4153.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing at least five +1/+1 counters from a creature you control and putting at least ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing five +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler and putting ten +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing ten +1/+1 counters from that creature and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability ten times by removing ten +1/+1 counters, adding {8}{W}{W}.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability any number of times.
1887-2060-4153.notes: Note that the starting mana can come from activating Crystalline Crawler's mana ability. Starting mana is reduced if the creature starts with more than five +1/+1 counters on it.

479-4755-4958.notablePrerequisites:
Emrakul has the greatest power among non-Human creatures you control.
You have no other cards in hand.
479-4755-4958.description:
Cast Return of the Wildspeaker by paying {4}{G}, causing you to draw thirteen cards.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.

2232-3172-3604.notablePrerequisites: You control Forests and/or green creatures that can tap to produce at least {8}{G}{G}.
2232-3172-3604.description:
Activate all Forests and mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{G}{G}.
Cast Patron of the Orochi by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Patron of the Orochi enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, cauisng you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Patron of the Orochi with haste.
The Patron of the Orochi token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Patron of the Orochi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Patron of the Orochi token by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures.
Activate all Forests and mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1087-1806-2034-3002.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is put into exile instead of your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Nalfeshnee triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Scourge with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1461-2178-4096.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goblin Welder.
You control a nontoken artifact creature.
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
1461-2178-4096.description:
Tap Goblin Welder, targeting the artifact creature on the battlefield and Wurmcoil Engine in your graveyard.
The artifact creature is sacrificed and Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield.
Goblin Welder triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Goblin Welder again, targeting the artifact creature in your graveyard and Wurmcoil Engine on the battlefield.
The artifact creature returns to the battlefield and Wurmcoil Engine is sacrificed.
Goblin Welder triggers, untapping itself.
Wurmcoil Engine triggers, creating 2 Wurm creature tokens.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

651-2603-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Grafted Wargear ability, attaching it to Task Force.
Repeat from step 1 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and by sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.
